scraperConfig.analyzerNotes: This is a Teamtailor-powered career site. The page shows 3 jobs (out of 56 total) filtered by map area. Job cards are in a ul#jobs_list_container with li elements. Each job has a title link and location/company info. The page uses JavaScript for rendering (data-controller attributes, Turbo frames). No pagination controls are visible on this filtered view - it shows "3 jobs (out of 56)" suggesting the full list would have pagination, but this specific map-filtered view shows all matching results on one page. The company field and location field both use the same selector (div.mt-1 span) and appear to show "CTS Group HQ" as the location. No salary, posting date, or description snippets are visible in the job cards.
